criteria.title: Distinguish owned, borrowed, shared, transferred, and weak references.
criteria.task: Draw ownership ledgers for one owned buffer, two borrowed views, a moved owner, a shared reference and a weak token. Mark the exact release obligation after each copy/move/drop; compare a raw C assignment with the intended logical move.
